cases.explain: «колючая ветка» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: Like a thorn bush that goes into the hand of a drunkard, so is a parable in the mouth of fools.

cases.explain: «лакомые куски» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: The words of a whisperer are as dainty morsels, they go down into the innermost parts.

cases.explain: «глиняный горшок» — the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: Like silver dross on an earthen vessel are the lips of a fervent one with an evil heart.

cases.explain: «Лживый язык» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: A lying tongue hates those it hurts; and a flattering mouth works ruin.
